summary: Delete a Time And Material Notification
description: Deleting a Time And Material Notification associated with the specified project

id.description: Unique identifier of the Time & Material notification configuration.

project_id.description: Identifier of the project this notification configuration belongs to.

company_id.description: Identifier of the company that owns this notification configuration.

creation.description: Array of user identifiers to notify when a Time & Material ticket is created.

customer_signed.description: Array of user identifiers to notify when a customer signs a Time & Material ticket.

company_signed.description: Array of user identifiers to notify when a company representative signs a Time & Material ticket.

closed.description: Array of user identifiers to notify when a Time & Material ticket is closed.

group_equipment_totals_by.description: Controls how equipment totals are grouped when pushing to change events. Values: none, per_ticket, per_change_event.

group_labor_totals_by.description: Controls how labor totals are grouped when pushing to change events. Values: none, per_ticket, per_change_event.

notify_dl_on_customer_signed.description: Whether to notify the project distribution list when a customer signs.

notify_dl_on_company_signed.description: Whether to notify the project distribution list when a company representative signs.

notify_dl_on_creation.description: Whether to notify the project distribution list when a ticket is created.

notify_dl_on_closed.description: Whether to notify the project distribution list when a ticket is closed.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this notification configuration was last modified, in ISO 8601 format.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this notification configuration was created, in ISO 8601 format.
